name: donepudi-me
description: donepudi.me's checks: the type checks, the site tests, and the Worker tests on the bundle wrangler's dry run writes. The site is the static folder site/, served by one Cloudflare Worker (wrangler.jsonc) that runs code only for /api/* and /threads/* (src/).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.site.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && deploy/node_modules/.bin/wrangler types --check --config wrangler.jsonc && node tools/frame/frame.ts --check
scripts.check: node tools/publish/run.ts --check && npm run typecheck && npm test
